reason: Connect the retort to hydrogen to prepare it for processing the iron-rich feedstock.
expectation: I expect the retort to gain a hydrogen supply for reducing iron compounds, though it may still need heating and feedstock.

alternatives.reason: The cable and steel may prepare equipment, but the hydrogen connection seems more directly relevant to the retort.

effect: The retort has a regulated hydrogen supply and contained exhaust; it still needs heating and feedstock.
reaction: The containment details make the setup feel physically grounded.
reason: Place the retort at the solar heating bay to prepare it for processing.
expectation: I expect the retort to be positioned for solar heating, though it may still need feedstock.

alternatives.reason: The cable and steel may make another useful device, but heating the retort seems more directly related to the goal.

effect: The hydrogen-fed retort is positioned at the heating bay; its processing setup is not yet complete.
reason: This is the only available combination, so I will use it to advance the setup.
expectation: I expect the cable and steel to make some powered equipment, but I cannot tell exactly what.

effect: The cable and steel made a switchable magnetic separator for preparing the regolith feedstock.
reaction: The explanation of how the coil collects and releases grains was useful.
reason: This is the only available combination, and it should separate suitable material from the screened regolith.
expectation: I expect the magnet to collect an iron-rich fraction for the retort, though it may need further processing.

effect: The separator produced an assayed iron-rich concentrate ready for the retort.
reaction: The distinction between the magnetic assay and the regolith's red colour was useful.
reason: Feed the concentrate into the heated, hydrogen-fed retort to make progress toward usable iron.
expectation: I expect hydrogen and heat to reduce the iron-bearing minerals, producing an iron-rich product that may need further processing.

alternatives.reason: Moving the retort would undo the heating setup rather than process the concentrate.

effect: The retort produced porous, weak reduced iron that needs further processing at the press.
reaction: The explanation clearly connected hydrogen reduction to the resulting metal's limitations.
reason: Press the iron sponge; it is the only available combination and should make the metal more usable.
expectation: I expect the press to compact the porous iron into a more useful form, though it may need additional treatment.

effect: The heated press consolidated the sponge into a dense billet, completing the iron goal; the next task is to shape a process frame.
reaction: The distinction between consolidating the iron and shaping parts makes sense.
reason: Use the billet at the press to work toward the process frame; it is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect the press to shape the iron into frame parts, though assembly may require another step.

effect: The billet is now shaped into non-pressure bars and brackets for the process frame.
reaction: The distinction from flight hardware makes the intended use clear.
reason: Fit the bars and brackets to the footing to build the frame; this is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect a supported process frame on the footing, though it may still need equipment installed.

effect: The bars and brackets completed a local-iron frame for the gas installation, finishing the chapter's goals.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the processed local material become a useful structure, even though the precision vessel is still separate.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reducing the concentrate and consolidating the porous iron made the transformation from mineral to usable metal clear, including why the sponge needed further work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the retort was straightforward but uneventful, especially when it left only one available combination.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the red colour alone did not establish whether the feedstock was suitable; the magnetic fraction and survey assay mattered.

arbitrary.text: The cable-and-steel combination was hard to anticipate before it produced an electromagnet. Its purpose made sense once explained, but I chose it because it was the only available combination.

continue.text: Yes. The practical explanations made the iron-making process interesting, and I would like to see how the gas installation supports the return and the preserved discovery.
